description: Check a proposed agent action against the organization's TrustModel policy before execution. Only the literal decision `allow` may proceed; deny, redact, unknown decisions, and transport failures block when fail-closed.

action_payload.description: Parameters or data the policy must evaluate.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent proposing the action.

policy_name.description: Policy name; defaults to the organization's default policy.

subject_id.description: Optional identifier for the person or resource affected.

name: trustmodel_guardrails_check
